en: Captain, Coro, what are\nyou guys up to?

The battle simulator has
not been functioning
properly, so we are
performing a little
maintenance on it.
Repair complete! I will try\nto boot it up.
Wow... Was our ship's\nbattle simulator always\nthis much fun?
Hm? Hmm!?
Coro!
Yes, Captain! I shall\nprepare a status report at\nonce!
This is Fun City on the\nartificial planet Energy\nNede!
The entire city is one big\ntheme park! It sure looks\nlike fun, right!?
I couldn't care less about\nthat. What I want to know\nis why we are even here.
Yes, about that...
A repair I made ended up\ntransporting us to this\npoint in space-time.
Grrr...
C-captain! Please do not\nlook at me like that. You\nare scaring me!

Besides, would you not
agree that this place looks
like a whole lot of fun!?
See how they are handing
out balloons over there!?

Umm, actually... I was
worried that you have
been working too hard
lately, Captain. So, this is
a personal favor to you!

I thought a change of
pace like this might be
just what the doctor
ordered! ...Or not...
Forgive me, Captain!

There is no need to be so
angry. I will make the
necessary repairs on the
double.

This theme park is huge.
Oh, it looks like there's a
battle arena over that
way.
Why don't we have some\nfun since we're already\nhere?
Yeah, why not. Let's have\nsome fun!
Let's train at the arena!
Let's buy some popcorn!
You heard Coro. Today's a\nday off. Let's have some\nfun!
(Wait, is this a date!?)
...Nah, it can't be!
Er, never mind! I was just\nthinking out loud. Come\non, let's go!

We're at a theme park and
you want to train? You
really are all business all
the time, aren't you?
I think I'll enjoy your heroic\nexploits from the stands.
But don't you dare lose. I'd\nnever forgive you!

Strolling around the theme
park with a bag of
popcorn does sound like
fun!
Oh, but there are so many\ndifferent flavors. How will I\never decide?
Hey, what's this flavor!?\nChocolate banana!?
Now for you, Captain, you\nshould get...
Okay, we have our\npopcorn. Let's move on!
Captain! The repair is\ncomplete!
I'll try to boot it up.
Why are you looking at me\nlike that, Evelysse!? Do\nyou not trust me?

I was just thinking we'll
probably end up fighting
for our lives in some crazy
dangerous situation again.

You know, like in the
middle of a raging battle
or on a planet on the
verge of collapsing...
Oh, please. What are the\nodds of something like\nthat happening again?
Okay, booting up the\nsystem!
Huh?
Where are we now?
Wait, how did this\nhappen?
Coro!
Maybe it was this circuit.\nHuh?
Heeelp!
Whew... We finally made it\nback.

Every time we boot up the
battle simulator, we end
up somewhere
unexpected.
Still, visiting so many\ndifferent places sure is\nfun!
Grrr!
...Or not! Sorry, Captain...
Yes, I agree. There's no\nplace like home.

Well, that was an
unplanned diversion. Let
us return to our previously
planned course posthaste!
Don't forget to repair the\nbattle simulator, Coro. And\ndo it right this time!
Yes, Eve. I will do my very\nbest...
